scenes.vo: My new flat's intercom rings every night at two fourteen. Nobody is ever downstairs.
scenes.cap: My intercom rings every night at 2:14. Nobody is downstairs.

scenes.vo: The guard showed me the lobby camera. Empty. Every night. Just the intercom light, blinking.
scenes.cap: The lobby camera: empty. Every single night.

scenes.vo: So I unplugged it. That night, at two fourteen, it rang anyway.
scenes.cap: I unplugged it. At 2:14, it rang anyway.

scenes.vo: I pressed talk and asked, who's there? A voice answered. My voice. It said, it's me. Open the door. I'm locked out.
scenes.cap: "Who's there?" My own voice: "It's me. I'm locked out."

scenes.vo: I laughed and turned around. Someone was asleep in my bed. Facing the wall. Wearing my clothes.
scenes.cap: Someone was asleep in my bed. Wearing my clothes.

scenes.vo: Then the intercom rang again. Two fourteen. Which one of us should open the door?
scenes.cap: The intercom rang again. 2:14. Who opens the door?
